description: Weekly dependency updates. The commit type decides the release (PUBLISHING.md): Go module updates ship in the provider and are fix(deps), a patch release; CI-only updates are ci(deps), which release nothing.

customManagers.description: semantic-release and its plugins, pinned in the release workflow

packageRules.description: Updates ship in the provider: fix(deps), a patch release.
Actions and release tooling only affect CI: ci(deps), no release.
The examples pin this provider itself and the docs are generated from them, so they are updated by hand.
Minor and patch updates come as one PR per area each week; majors get their own PRs.
